name: Junk's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: A joke gambit that does nothing; its card text re-rolls to a random rule description each time it appears.
description: A one-coin prank card: the gambit itself has no gameplay effect (its trigger only plays the standard visual effect), but every time the card appears its description is re-rolled from a pool of 25 texts that mostly restate vanilla game rules, so it always claims to do something it doesn't. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
